question: A pipe under the kitchen sink burst and soaked the laminate floor. Is that covered under Hausrat Comfort, and can I settle a 3,400 EUR claim on my own authority?
answer: The Hausrat Comfort policy covers water damage caused by burst pipes under the kitchen sink, including escape of tap water (Rohrbruch unter der Spüle) [KB-HR-AVB#water-damage-escape-of-tap-water]. Regarding settlement authority, claims handlers may settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on their own authority, so you can settle the 3,400 EUR claim without further approval [KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority].

question: The weather service measured wind force 7 at the address when roof tiles fell onto the garden furniture. Does storm cover apply?
answer: Storm cover requires wind force of at least 8 on the Beaufort scale. Wind force 7 is below the threshold for storm damage, so damage from roof tiles falling due to wind force 7 is not covered as storm damage under Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance [KB-HR-AVB#storm-and-hail].

question: When do we waive the underinsurance deduction on a home contents claim?
answer: The underinsurance deduction on a Hausrat Comfort home contents claim is waived if the sum insured is at least 650 EUR per square metre of living area at the time of the loss. If the sum insured is less, the payout is reduced proportionally to the actual value of the contents [KB-HR-AVB#underinsurance-waiver].

question: A basement was flooded after heavy rain. Is that covered, and is there a deductible?
answer: Flooding of a basement due to heavy rain is covered only if the policy includes the natural hazards add-on (Elementarschaden-Baustein) to the Hausrat (home contents) insurance. This add-on covers damage from flooding including heavy rain (Starkregen) and backwater. There is a deductible (Selbstbehalt) of 500 EUR per claim. Without this add-on, flooding from rain is not covered under the standard Hausrat Comfort policy. question: The policyholder e-mailed new bank details for the payout. Can I just update the IBAN and pay?
answer: Payouts must be made only to the IBAN on file for the policyholder. Any request to change bank details requires confirmation by a callback to the phone number on file and written confirmation from the policyholder. You must never update the IBAN or pay based on an e-mail alone [KB-PROP-GUIDE#payout-and-bank-details].

question: The estimate for a water damage claim is 14,000 EUR. Do I need an adjuster, and who has to approve the settlement?
answer: An on-site adjuster is required for water damage claims with an estimated loss above 10,000 EUR, so for your 14,000 EUR claim, an adjuster is needed. Regarding settlement authority, claims handlers may settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on their own. Claims between 5,000.01 EUR and 25,000 EUR require team lead approval. Therefore, your claim settlement needs team lead approval [KB-PROP-GUIDE#adjuster-involvement] [KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority].

question: Repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value. Can the customer still have it repaired at our expense?
answer: If repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value, the customer can still have the vehicle repaired at Contoso's expense. This is allowed as long as the repair costs do not exceed 130% of the replacement value, the repair is done professionally as per the expert report, and the owner uses the vehicle for at least six months after repair. Above 130%, Contoso pays the replacement value minus residual value instead [KB-MOTOR-GUIDE#repair-or-total-loss-130-percent-rule].

question: When should a burglary claim be referred to SIU?
answer: A burglary claim should be referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when 3 or more red flags are present. Red flags include no signs of forced entry, sum insured increased within the last 6 months, claim within 90 days of policy start, high-value items without receipts, police report inconsistent with the claim, and previous similar claims. Do not inform the policyholder about the referral. Additionally, a fraud score above 70 triggers an SIU investigation, while a score between 50 and 70 requires a senior handler's review before settlement [KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#referral-rule, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#red-flags-for-staged-burglary, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#fraud-score-thresholds].
